name: Greubel Forsey Tourbillon 24 Seconds White Gold 43,5mm 24 Months Warranty GF01PTCN
description: The Greubel Forsey Tourbillon 24 Seconds in White Gold is a stunning example of advanced watchmaking. With a case size of 43.5mm, this timepiece houses the Tourbillon 24 Seconds movement, a highly complex and unique feature developed by Greubel Forsey. The watch is powered by a manual movement with a 24-second tourbillon that rotates once every 24 seconds, significantly improving timekeeping accuracy. Crafted from white gold, this exquisite piece blends high-end materials with cutting-edge technology. The watch is also equipped with a 24-month warranty for added peace of mind. The GF01PTCN reference signifies its unique model with intricate attention to detail, a hallmark of Greubel Forsey's commitment to Haute Horlogerie. This timepiece is not only a work of precision and innovation but also a luxury statement, designed for collectors and connoisseurs of fine watchmaking.

description: The DATOGRAPH PERPETUAL TOURBILLON HONEYGOLD “Lumen” unites three significant complications in a case made of 18-carat HONEYGOLD®: a flyback chronograph, a perpetual calendar and a tourbillon with a stop-seconds mechanism. name: Blancpain Carrousel Répétition Minutes
description: This grand complication is the premiere in the history of watchmaking, combining a one-minute flying carrousel and a minute repeater with cathedral chimes. One-minute flying carrousel Designed to counteract the perturbations induced by gravity on the accuracy of watches, the carrousel is a rare and fascinating complication. Blancpain has revived this device and incorporated it into a wristwatch for the first time.
